newsitem.title: PERU: Grenade blast in Peru kills three, injures 11.
newsitem.headline: Grenade blast in Peru kills three, injures 11.

text.p: Three children died and 11 other people were injured Friday when a grenade the children were playing with exploded at a market in a poor Lima neighbourhood, police said.
"We have three fatalities, all minors, and 11 people injured, some of them seriously," a police spokesman said. He said the children were aged 14, 12 and 9.
Local radio said the children found the grenade along the banks of the nearby Rimac River and were taking it to the market where they worked when it exploded.
